g.text: Where the name comes from: Thinking, Fast and Slow
Daniel Kahneman, 2011: two modes of thought
also: reading a face, a short word,
also: filling in a tax form,
The same split in AI models
System One models (Jev, VideoJev): one forward pass → a typed decision with probabilities
LLMs that write free text; 'Thinking' mode: reason step by step, then answer
Kahneman: we use System 1 most of the time and call System 2 when it is needed. VideoJev aims for the same split.
D. Kahneman, Thinking, Fast and Slow (2011); 17 × 24 is Kahneman's own example. Book drawn generically, not the cover
